{{Quote|If you'll come back, why did you tell us what to do if you don't?" Joveh D'a Alin pointed out.<br />"Scientists. You're so logical.|Scientist Joveh D'a Alin questions Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref>}}
'''Joveh D'a Alin''' was a blue-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], an expert in the field of planetary tectonics and mineralogy, who lived in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], Joveh D'a Alin, a compassionate person who also had trained as a medic before obtaining her scientific degree, traveled with fellow scientists [[Granta Omega|Tic Verdun]], [[Fort Turan]], [[Reug Yucon]], and [[Talie Heathe]] on an expedition to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haariden]] to carry out investigations on geological and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activities there, to accomplish global mapping for the mineral [[titanite]], and to determine the effects of the world's environment on its ecosystem.

In the midst of their research, however, the scientists found themselves caught up in a raging civil war and soon became stranded when their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] malfunctioned. Pinned down in the countryside, they were able to send a distress call to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] (the sponsor of their mapping mission) while attempting to negotiate a truce between the opposing forces on the planet. Fearing that the scientists would be held as hostages or bargaining chips in the ongoing conflict, the Senate appealed to the Jedi for help.

The scientists were eventually found by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Soara Antana/Legends|Soara Antana]], and [[Darra Thel-Tanis]], who were dispatched on a [[Mission to Haariden|rescue mission]] to the crisis-bound planet by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. From a deserted village holdout (in war-besieged [[Tenuuri]]), the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]—leading them safely through perilous, war-pocked terrain—protected the scientists, until all were able eventually to flee the planet.
